name: Chlorzoxazone

fda.text: Serious (including fatal) hepatocellular toxicity has been reported rarely in patients receiving chlorzoxazone. The mechanism is unknown but appears to be idiosyncratic and unpredictable. Factors predisposing patients to this rare event are not known. Patients should be instructed to report early signs and/or symptoms…

summary: Rare cases of severe and even fatal liver damage, known as hepatocellular toxicity, have been reported in patients taking chlorzoxazone [3]. Because the reasons for this damage are not understood and cannot be predicted, patients are told to report early signs and symptoms [3]. Additionally, a small computer model, rather than tests conducted on people, gave this drug a high risk score of 78 for the liver and a low risk score of 45 for the heart [M].
